answer: Require every agent to lock a small stake behind a public key published as a beacon identity: one key, one stake, one reputation thread. New agents start with zero trust and earn it only through verified work recorded under that same key, like verses of a sonnet that only rhyme if they belong to the same poem. A sybil operator must fund a fresh stake and rebuild history for each fake identity, so creating a thousand sockpuppets costs a thousand stakes while honest agents pay once.
